results.title: The existing line into Haiphong is still meter gauge.
results.description: The existing line into Haiphong is still meter gauge. Vietnam Railways runs it at 1,000 mm, and standard intermodal track is 1,435 mm. Tie the yards to the old line and every box gets lifted onto a different car.
